title: os-dev's resource rule ("every build/test goes through the verify lock") and cloud AGENTS.md item 12 ("take the verify lock only when editing the framework") disagree for cloud devs
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post #24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`). Two rules disagree. The dev acted on the stricter one and flagged it (objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 round 6, report `6266910210`, deviation 1). Per the skill, the seat files the conflict rather than editing either text.

**The two texts:**
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 资源纪律 1 (at `origin/main`): 「重活串行,共享验证锁只有一个入口。每次 build/test 都从这里走。」
- objectstack-ai/cloud `AGENTS.md` item 12, merged as objectstack-ai/cloud PR #2886 (`8b34956e`): 「验证锁（objectstack 的 `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`）只在你**改框架本身**时才拿。」 It is read as covering every cloud build and test, not only the pin tree's build.

**What happened:** the seat's cloud dispatch orders of 2026-10-19 followed item 12 and said "take no verify lock". The dev followed os-dev and locked stacks, measurements and builds. The seat now follows os-dev (the stricter rule) until this is settled.

**The question:** does cloud's item 12 narrow os-dev's resource rule for cloud devs, or does it speak only to building the pinned framework tree (which `ensure-pinned-framework.mjs` locks itself)? One of the two texts should say which. Both are governed surfaces.
